Official reference: Project files and packages

richText: pom.xml declares Maven dependencies and build plugins. A Gradle project uses build.gradle or build.gradle.kts.
The wrapper runs the build tool version selected by the project. Java must still be installed.
src/main/java contains Java source files. src/main/resources contains configuration and packaged resources.
src/test/java contains test code. Maven writes build output to target; Gradle normally uses build.
A package groups Java classes under a name such as com.example.demo.
Put the application class in that package and application components in its subpackages. Spring scans this package tree by default.
A folder name does not make a class a Spring bean. The class must be registered with Spring.
